aboutPage.title:
A little about me,
and what drives me.
aboutPage.intro: I'm Tai, a developer who enjoys building for the web and sharing lessons from the journey.
aboutPage.storyTitle: From lines of code to something useful.
storyParagraphs: I'm working towards being a fullstack developer: going beyond interfaces to understand how APIs, databases, and infrastructure come together in a complete product.
I enjoy solving practical problems, understanding why a solution works, and improving things a little at a time. Every project is also an opportunity to learn something new.
aboutPage.quote: Learn by building. Write to understand.
aboutPage.principlesDescription: The principles I work towards when writing code and building products.

principles.title: Understand the problem
principles.description: Start with practical needs and the user experience, then choose technology that fits the problem.

principles.title: Keep things clear
principles.description: Favor readable code, components with clear responsibilities, and solutions that match the scope.

principles.title: Learn and share
principles.description: Write down experiments, problems, and solutions to understand more deeply and help others learn along the way.
